title: Opt-in read-only toolchain mapping in kbingest
goal: python3 _tools/kbingest.py map REPO --rev REV checks out the commit into a scratch worktree and, for each language whose toolchain is installed, runs only the read-only commands of agents/codebase-mapping.csv (go list -e -json with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, cargo metadata --no-deps --offline --locked, dotnet msbuild -getProperty/-getItem without -target and dotnet package list --no-restore, npm ls --json --package-lock-only, tsc --showConfig/--listFilesOnly, python -m ast in a subprocess), with a timeout and no network flags, and writes one JSON map per language (packages, imports, entry points) naming the tool version under _cache/ingest/, never under kb/; a missing toolchain is a note, not an error; the survey never runs it.

gates.question: May kbingest.py run a repository's installed toolchains (subprocesses other than git), limited to the read-only forms in agents/codebase-mapping.csv, in a scratch worktree with a timeout?
options: approve: the read-only command list, scratch worktree, timeout, no network flags
parsers only: python -m ast in a subprocess and ctags, no language toolchains
no: tool-native mapping stays a manual step in /kb-ingest
gates.recommendation: approve: the read-only command list, scratch worktree, timeout, no network flags
gates.answer: approve: the read-only command list, scratch worktree, timeout, no network flags

notes: Read-only forms and their side effects: agents/codebase-mapping.md, 'How it fits an ingesting agent'. The mapper tasks share kbingest.py, so they run one after another.
